def main():
    # Disable automatic flushing for faster I/O
    sys.stdout.flush()
    
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    data = []
    
    for _ in range(n):
        x = int(sys.stdin.readline())
        data.append(x)
    
    # Find the median using nth_element equivalent
    data.sort()
    print(data[n // 2])
